purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Foz do Iguaçu

queries.query: Foz do Iguaçu official cadastral map parcel viewer GIS municipality Brazil
queries.result: Search identified the first-party Foz do Iguaçu GeoPortal hosted at fozhabita.ctmgeo.com.br; its indexed description says it provides municipal parcel/lot cadastral information and map identification.

queries.query: Foz do Iguaçu cadastro imobiliário mapa lotes prefeitura geoprocessamento
queries.result: Search identified the first-party municipal GeoPortal and official municipal documents describing Cadastro Imobiliário and lote/parcel procedures. The GeoPortal municipality selector lists Município de Foz do Iguaçu, IBGE 4108304, PR.

registryEvidence.custodian: Município de Foz do Iguaçu municipal cadastral/GeoPortal service, hosted by CTMGEO
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The municipal GeoPortal is a local public cadastral map/procedure route. CTMGEO appears to host the application; no underlying parcel service endpoint was successfully reached in this attempt.

parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel ID+geometry response was obtained. The public route exposed the municipality selector, but navigation from index.ctm to municipios.ctm and back to index.ctm looped anonymously; this is an unusable UI/app-route outcome, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 302 to /geo-view/municipios.ctm; anonymous session cookie issued.
HTTP 302 back to /geo-view/index.ctm; repeated anonymous redirect loop, so no map/config/schema response was available.
HTTP 200 JSF municipality selector; observed Foz do Iguaçu entry with IBGE 4108304 and PR, plus public home.xhtml command-link route. No login or CAPTCHA was used.
Official municipal service document retrieved; describes cadastral numbering of approved subdivision lots and municipal planning/urbanism procedure.
Official municipal organizational page retrieved via search; identifies the municipal Cadastro Imobiliário division. Direct request route was not needed for the evidence packet.

uncertainty: The local municipal GeoPortal and municipal cadastral procedure are evidenced, but the underlying public map/API service could not be reached beyond the selector in this attempt.
No exact-point or bounded parcel query was completed; this is not evidence of parcel absence or map extent miss.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
